content:
maria_fin: Heads-up — Velora Health (cust VL-3342) autopay failed and the account is locked after 3 card declines. Invoice INV-2026-78 is pending $12,480. Processor returned an 'authorization lockout' and blocked further attempts. Can ops/finance do a manual override or process via ACH? Customer is asking for next steps.

josh_ops: On it. Can you paste the payment method id + last4 and any processor error? I'll check whether we can force a one-off charge.

maria_fin: pm_abc123xyz last4 4242
```
processor_response: card_declined
decline_code: authorization_required
lockout: true
attempts: 3
``` 

sam_revenue: We need to follow our manual-charge policy: requires finance + legal sign-off if customer is revenue-risk flagged. Is Velora on the revenue-risk list?

maria_fin: They're flagged low-risk but they have overdue invoices >30d. I'd prefer ACH debit if possible — customer offered bank details. But we need to be PCI-safe.

claudia_legal: Legal here — approve one-off manual charge ONLY if we have explicit written consent on record or customer signs the charge authorization. If they provide bank details, we must use our ACH debit flow and store consent. Otherwise we need a signed form.

josh_ops: Understood. @maria_fin can you confirm customer consent? If yes I'll generate the secure payment link or trigger ACH debit (if we have microdeposit setup). Which do they want?

maria_fin: Customer ok with ACH debit. They prefer we initiate. I'll send the consent email template now and ask them to reply. In the meantime, can we put a hold on dunning emails so we don't auto-escalate?

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-3921: manual-payment-override-request for INV-2026-78; assigned to josh_ops. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/tickets/BILL-3921

josh_ops: Pausing dunning for this customer — turned off auto-retry for 24h.

maria_fin: Received written consent via email (screenshot uploaded to ticket). Proceeding with ACH debit today. I'll update when settled. :thumbsup:

josh_ops: ACH debit initiated, bank tx id: ach_7721xxx. Will update when settled (2-3 business days).

maria_fin: Thanks team. Marking invoice as 'collecting' in CRM until settlement completes.
